title: Determinantes da permanência e do êxito estudantil: o papel integrador da família e das redes colaborativas de apoio Determinants of Student Retention and Success: The Integrative Role of Family and Collaborative Support Networks Determinantes de la permanencia y del éxito estudiantil: el papel integrador de la familia y de las redes colaborativas de apoyo
text_snippet: Determinantes da permanência e do êxito estudantil: o papel integrador da família e das redes colaborativas de apoio Determinants of Student Retention and Success: The Integrative Role of Family and Collaborative Support Networks Determinantes de la permanencia y del éxito estudiantil: el papel integrador de la familia y de las redes colaborativas de apoyo Full-Time High School has been adopted as a strategy to promote comprehensive education and school retention. However, extending the time spent at school does not, by itself, guarantee better learning outcomes. This study analyzes how family participation, mediated by digital technologies, can foster attendance and enrich teaching– learning processes. The research, using a qualitative–quantitative approach, was conducted in a public school with attendance and academic performance data from two first-year classes in 2025. The results show a consistent relationship between attendance and performance: attendance rates below 80–85% are associated with unsatisfactory grades. The strategic role of family participation as an educational mediator is highlighted.

title: Sentidos del arte en el adulto mayor, una experiencia de descubrimientos y aprendizajes sensibles The meaning of art in older adults: an experience of discovery and sensitive learning
text_snippet: Sentidos del arte en el adulto mayor, una experiencia de descubrimientos y aprendizajes sensibles The meaning of art in older adults: an experience of discovery and sensitive learning The stage in arts is a subject of the degree in physical education, recreation and sports at the University of Cauca, which carries out educational practices from different artistic languages in groups of senior citizens in the city of Popayan. This academic process, some experiences of sensitive experiences were generated from varieties artistic expressions, from the language of plastic arts, dance and recreational dramatic games, stimulating creativity, imagination, camaraderie emotions of this population, this article is aimed at revealing the meanings of art in four groups of senior citizens. The methodology used was comprehensive hermeneutics, the findings of this research are framed in categories in how art stimulates the bonds of camaraderie the communicative sense of the elderly, artistic spaces allow you to forget about problems for a moment and stimulate attention.

title: Creación participativa de un repositorio digital para la enseñanza y preservación de la cultura Kamëntsá con estudiantes de grado 11 de la Institución Educativa Normal Superior de Sibundoy, Putumayo Participatory Creation of a Digital Repository for Teaching and Preserving Kamëntsá Culture with 11th‑Grade Students at Institución Educativa Normal Superior Sibundoy, Putumayo
text_snippet: Creación participativa de un repositorio digital para la enseñanza y preservación de la cultura Kamëntsá con estudiantes de grado 11 de la Institución Educativa Normal Superior de Sibundoy, Putumayo Participatory Creation of a Digital Repository for Teaching and Preserving Kamëntsá Culture with 11th‑Grade Students at Institución Educativa Normal Superior Sibundoy, Putumayo Education in multicultural contexts faces the challenge of integrating ancestral knowledge with contemporary technological demands. This article presents the results of a research project aimed at evaluating the participatory creation of a digital repository as a pedagogical strategy for the teaching and preservation of traditional knowledge of the Kamëntsá culture in Sibundoy, Putumayo. Using a mixed-methods approach and a Participatory Action Research (par) design, the study worked with 11th-grade students and indigenous knowledge keepers (sabedores) to systematize bead weaving and wood carving practices. Results show that 54.2 % of students rediscovered unknown cultural aspects, and 58.3 % rated the experience as significant. It is concluded that technological mediation, far from alienating, served as a bridge for identity resignification and the development of digital and collaborative skills.

title: Currículo en ciencias. Una revisión desde el desarrollo profesional docente y las habilidades blandas Science curriculum. A review from the perspective of professional teacher development and soft skills
text_snippet: Currículo en ciencias. Una revisión desde el desarrollo profesional docente y las habilidades blandas Science curriculum. A review from the perspective of professional teacher development and soft skills The science curriculum has been studied from various perspectives, with the logical sequence of content being the most frequently addressed. However, in science education, it is important to conceive of the curriculum as extending beyond conceptual mastery. For this reason, this article seeks to explore the relationship between this subject of study and fields such as teacher professional development and soft skills. To this end, a systematic literature review was conducted using the PRISMA method in databases such as Scopus, covering the period from 2021 to 2025, applying inclusion and exclusion criteria across three stages of screening. The results yielded twelve publications that explicitly and implicitly address aspects related to teacher education beginning in the early stages of schooling. Soft skills are described as attitudes, values, emotions, and behaviors in science learning. These findings are compared with research published in Colombian indexed journals, revealing both similarities and gaps. The study concludes with a conceptual proposal for a science curriculum model focused on integrating professional development and soft skills in initial teacher education.

title: Interpretación literaria e integración de contextos interdisciplinarios desde la hermenéutica humanizadora de Graciela Maturo Literary interpretation and integration of interdisciplinary contexts from Graciela Maturo's humanizing hermeneutics
text_snippet: Interpretación literaria e integración de contextos interdisciplinarios desde la hermenéutica humanizadora de Graciela Maturo Literary interpretation and integration of interdisciplinary contexts from Graciela Maturo's humanizing hermeneutics The research was conducted at IE Colegio Técnico La Presentación in Pamplona (Norte de Santander, Colombia), taking as a frame of reference Graciela Maturo’s Humanizing Hermeneutics in literary interpretation in ninth grade students. This approach advocates establishing a dialogue between the text, author, context and reader, in order to understand both the literal elements of the texts and the historical, social and cultural context in which each work and literary movement is inscribed, thus promoting a humanizing reading and a deep interpretation. A qualitative approach was used with an Action Research method, which included an initial test, interdisciplinary analysis strategies and dialogue spaces such as literary circles. The results showed significant progress in the argumentative capacity of the students, the development of critical thinking, the capacity for interdisciplinary analysis and interest in the understanding of literature and its background.

title: Percepción docente sobre competencias socioemocionales en la educación inicial Teachers' perception of socio-emotional skills in early childhood education
text_snippet: Percepción docente sobre competencias socioemocionales en la educación inicial Teachers' perception of socio-emotional skills in early childhood education This research analyzes teachers’ perceptions, knowledge, and practices regarding socioemotional education in early childhood. The study uses a qualitative methodological approach. The results highlight the importance of individual teacher characteristics, family inclusion, and interdisciplinary work in developing these competencies. It also highlights the limited professional training of teachers to address children’s socioemotional needs. Among the most notable strategies are assertive communication and project-based work, key to comprehensive care in this area. The main conclusions are that university centers currently do not provide sufficient preparation for teachers to address socioemotional competencies in schools. This challenge does not depend solely on the motivation and personal qualities of the educator but requires a systemic approach. The school-family-student triad forms the basis for a successful educational process, where communication, empathy, and sensitivity emerge as fundamental pillars in a child’s academic, emotional, and social integration development.

title: Videojuego diseñado en Scratch como puente didáctico entre pensamiento computacional y aprendizaje de ecuaciones lineales en educación básica Scratch-Designed Video Game as a Didactic Bridge between Computational Thinking and the Learning of Linear Equations in Basic Education
text_snippet: Videojuego diseñado en Scratch como puente didáctico entre pensamiento computacional y aprendizaje de ecuaciones lineales en educación básica Scratch-Designed Video Game as a Didactic Bridge between Computational Thinking and the Learning of Linear Equations in Basic Education Many students experience difficulties in understanding and solving linear equations due to challenges related to sequencing steps, identifying errors, and applying logical reasoning. This research presents the design and implementation of a Scratch-based video game aimed at promoting computational-thinking subskills to support problem solving of linear equations. The study adopts a mixed-methods approach conducted across three stages of implementation and evaluation with sixth-, seventh-, and eighth-grade students. Data were collected through a qualitative rubric and pretest-posttest workshops. The study concludes that the video game is a didactic resource for supporting the learning of linear equations and enhancing computational thinking subskills.

title: Herramientas neuropedagógicas y pensamiento computacional en educación secundaria: estudio confirmatorio en instituciones públicas de Chía, Colombia Neuropedagogical tools and computational thinking in secondary education: A confirmatory study in public schools in Chía, Colombia
text_snippet: Herramientas neuropedagógicas y pensamiento computacional en educación secundaria: estudio confirmatorio en instituciones públicas de Chía, Colombia Neuropedagogical tools and computational thinking in secondary education: A confirmatory study in public schools in Chía, Colombia This article analyzes the relationship between the use of neuropedagogical tools by Technology and Computer Science teachers and the development of computational thinking in ninth-grade students from public schools in Chía, Cundinamarca. A confirmatory, field, and cross-sectional study was conducted with 271 students and 8 teachers. The Computational Thinking Test and a scale for the use of neuropedagogical tools, designed specifically for this study, were administered. The results show low performance in computational thinking and average teacher performance in the use of these tools. An overall correlation was found; however, when controlling extraneous variables, significant but negative relationships emerged. Multivariate analysis indicates that the use of these tools contributes to the development of computational thinking under certain conditions.

title: From Turkish to Spanish: Challenges and Strategies of Language Learning Del turco al español: retos y estrategias del aprendizaje de idiomas
text_snippet: From Turkish to Spanish: Challenges and Strategies of Language Learning Del turco al español: retos y estrategias del aprendizaje de idiomas Learning Spanish is one of the biggest obstacles Turkish women face when moving to Colombia. Although cultural and linguistic differences sometimes make this process isolating and challenging, it also yields stories of adaptation and empowerment. By exploring the challenges and the emotional and practical struggles that Turkish women in Bogotá face as they learn Spanish, this article aims to give their voices visibility and inspire others on similar journeys.

title: ¿Puede la inteligencia artificial mejorar la expresión oral en inglés? Una revisión sistemática Can artificial intelligence improve spoken English? A systematic review
text_snippet: ¿Puede la inteligencia artificial mejorar la expresión oral en inglés? Una revisión sistemática Can artificial intelligence improve spoken English? A systematic review The purpose of this systematic review is to specify all surrounding conceptions towards the development of communication skills and artificial intelligence, specifically making an approach to English as a foreign language. According to the design, the well-known document review is applied through a qualitative approach; similarly, tracing process is developed through the Boolean operators and, not and or. Regarding the findings, all definitions about oral-communicative skills and their several connotations in the field of language development are highlighted, a factor that blurs their scope from English teaching. Likewise, the discussion of concepts related to artificial intelligence and virtual learning environments is accomplished as paralleled concepts that work independently in their disciplinary form. As a conclusion, it is necessary to stress the discre­pancy that exists between the implementation of artificial intelligence in learning processes.

title: Comunidades educativas en territorios rurales: narrativas docentes sobre las condiciones laborales en el Antropoceno Educational communities in rural territories: Teacher narratives on working conditions in the Anthropocene
text_snippet: Comunidades educativas en territorios rurales: narrativas docentes sobre las condiciones laborales en el Antropoceno Educational communities in rural territories: Teacher narratives on working conditions in the Anthropocene This article analyzes teaching working conditions in rural schools in the Piemonte da Diamantina Identity Territory, Bahia, connecting teachers' narratives with the theoretical debate on educational communities and the Anthropocene. Based on narrative interviews and comprehensive-interpretative analysis, central contradictions that permeate rural teaching were identified: on the one hand, structural precariousness, such as lack of infrastructure, low wages, multiple employment relationships, and insufficient initial training; on the other, community-based pedagogical practices that mobilize local knowledge, strengthen bonds of belonging, and configure rural teaching as a practice of resistance. The analysis shows that rural schools, even in adverse contexts, constitute spaces for memory, care, and pedagogical reinvention, assuming ethical and political relevance in confronting contemporary socio-environmental crises. The results highlight the need to strengthen public policies that value teachers and to deepen research that articulates education, socio-environmental justice, and educational communities within the Anthropocene.

title: “Como círculos concéntricos, de mi ser a la comunidad”: la formación de sí y la acción en el mundo mediante el Modelo Educativo Etievan “Like concentric circles, from my being to the community”: self-formation and action in the world through the Etievan Educational Model
text_snippet: “Como círculos concéntricos, de mi ser a la comunidad”: la formación de sí y la acción en el mundo mediante el Modelo Educativo Etievan “Like concentric circles, from my being to the community”: self-formation and action in the world through the Etievan Educational Model The notion of Anthropocene compel us to question the possibilities of promoting, in the field of education, real changes in the ways we inhabit the planet and relate to ourselves, other beings, and the world. In light of this question, this article focuses on the Etievan Model, a broad educational perspective aimed at uniting mind, body, and emotion in favour of a harmonious development of the human being. In a study conducted in accordance with the theoretical and methodological references of biographical research in education, biographical interviews and workshops were carried out, in which educators and learners recounted their experiences with this comprehensive education. The transcreated narratives were interpreted from a hermeneutic perspective using the key concept of normosis. This reveals a rich repertoire of practical insights into how to educate the dimensions of being and knowing, in a more balanced way. By sharing experiential and sensitive learning itineraries through the cultivation of the love of effort and the development of attention, the narratives reveal an approach according to which the a

title: La educación en el Antropoceno: retos y perspectivas para el futuro Education in the Anthropocene: Challenges and Perspectives for the Future
text_snippet: La educación en el Antropoceno: retos y perspectivas para el futuro Education in the Anthropocene: Challenges and Perspectives for the Future The term “Anthropocene” is used to describe the role of humans in the world, characterized by the fact that humans largely determine the fate of the planet, experiencing at the same time their power and their powerlessness. The term must not be limited only to climate change, destruction of biodiversity, biogeochemical cycles, acidification of the oceans, pollution of the planet, and threatening the livelihood of humans, animals, and plants. The concept of the “Anthropocene” characterizes a new global view of humans and the world that intertwines with all social and cultural domains. Among others, it also includes, for example: 1) machine worlds, 2) digital transformation including artificial intelligence and robotics, 3) genetics and biotechnology. With the help of the 2030 Agenda, the aim is to save the vital foundations of human life. This agenda can be classified into five areas: 'people' (poverty and hunger, life in dignity, equality, healthy environment), 'planet' (protection of ecosystems), 'peace' (inclusion, peace, justice), 'prosperity' (welfare of all people through economic and technical development), 'participation'. title: Voces del Territorio: Narrativas del Campesinado Sobre Acciones Educativas en el Proceso de Delimitación del Páramo Cruz Verde-Sumapaz Voices of the Territory: Community Narratives of Peasants on Educational Processes in the Delimitation of the Cruz Verde-Sumapaz Páramo
text_snippet: Voces del Territorio: Narrativas del Campesinado Sobre Acciones Educativas en el Proceso de Delimitación del Páramo Cruz Verde-Sumapaz Voices of the Territory: Community Narratives of Peasants on Educational Processes in the Delimitation of the Cruz Verde-Sumapaz Páramo This work presents and makes visible the community narratives of peasants living in the Cruz Verde-Sumapaz páramo, regarding education as a right, educational processes within the framework of the delimitation of this ecosystem, and those that will take place once the corresponding declaration is issued. The study was conducted through narrative research from a socio-critical narrative inquiry approach, based on the collection of community narratives, participant observation, and the construction of a report endorsed and validated by social agents as a product of phase 3 of consultation and initiative. The results reveal that the peasants of Sumapaz demand an education with a territorial, peasant, and popular focus, distinguished by the dialogue of knowledge, that projects opportunities for human well-being and the conservation of the páramo, without colonizing their own knowledge.

title: Las narrativas de la comunidad educativa y el horizonte institucional: tensiones y convergencias en la construcción de identidad escolar. Narratives of the Educational Community and the Institutional Horizon: Tensions and Convergences in the Construction of School Identity
text_snippet: Las narrativas de la comunidad educativa y el horizonte institucional: tensiones y convergencias en la construcción de identidad escolar. Narratives of the Educational Community and the Institutional Horizon: Tensions and Convergences in the Construction of School Identity This qualitative study, using a hermeneutic approach and discourse analysis, examines the relationship between the narratives of the educational community and the institutional horizon at the Rural Educational Institution Carbonera (Andes, Antioquia). Through semi-structured interviews and conceptual matrices, it identifies convergences, dissonances, and discursive gaps between the voices of students, families, and teachers and the official institutional document. Findings reveal a gap between institutional norms and local experiences. The study proposes a reformulation of the institutional horizon based on a polyphonic narrative identity that acknowledges context and promotes a democratic, participatory, and situated school, particularly in rural settings.

title: Os mortos e suas histórias de vida Los muertos y sus historias de vida
text_snippet: Os mortos e suas histórias de vida Los muertos y sus historias de vida Nos inspiramos en la riqueza ontológica de nuestra investigación biográfica con la comunidad de Mangueira, Río de Janeiro, Brasil, desde 2003. Buscamos comprender una memoria-composición, impulsada por la forma más radical del amor, lo común, este reservorio de heterogeneidad. Nuestro dispositivo de inves­tigación es la comunidad de relatos orales de vida, donde la narración, como proceso de producción de memoria, se comparte con todos los presentes, vivos y muertos, entre recordados y recordadores, entre pasado y presente. Esta compo­sición está abierta a las potencialidades experimentales de nuestro campo de trabajo, en constante desequilibrio, en el aquí y ahora de la experiencia narrativa, donde los muertos y los vivos tienen sus propios modos de existencia.

title: Subjetividad docente y análisis crítico del discurso: marco conceptual para la práctica formativa lasallista en educación superior Teacher Subjectivity and Critical Discourse Analysis: A Conceptual Framework for Lasallian Formative Practice in Higher Education
text_snippet: Subjetividad docente y análisis crítico del discurso: marco conceptual para la práctica formativa lasallista en educación superior Teacher Subjectivity and Critical Discourse Analysis: A Conceptual Framework for Lasallian Formative Practice in Higher Education The teaching and learning process that takes place in the classroom occurs through discursive interactions that reveal the teacher’s positioning in relation to institutional mandates and contextual constraints. Drawing on analogical hermeneutics, an interpretive process is developed, weaving together theoretical contributions from critical discourse analysis, key challenges currently facing higher education instructors, and Lasallian educational principles as a foundation for their professional practice. As a result, a conceptual framework is abductively constructed, which will need to be tested and validated through future empirical research.

title: Tormentas antropocénicas y comunidad activa: algunas características a favor de la vivifiance Tourmentes anthropocéniques et communauté agissante : quelques caractéristiques en faveur de la vivifiance
text_snippet: Tormentas antropocénicas y comunidad activa: algunas características a favor de la vivifiance Tourmentes anthropocéniques et communauté agissante : quelques caractéristiques en faveur de la vivifiance Face aux multiples expériences existentielles en tension : entre d’un côté, des pratiques politiques de gouvernance par sidération et provocation, sans projet sociétal en faveur du respect des vivants, l’omniprésence d’un modèle économique aux effets délétères sur la biosphère terrestre, au déferlement d’informations incontrôlables ; et, de l’autre, des initiatives locales respectueuses de la biodiversité et des liens d’interdépendance entre les êtres, promouvant par participation de tous les acteurs, il est fondamental d’atterrir en entrant en résis­tance grâce à l’exercice de la pensée afin de prendre du recul, redéfinir les notions et les valeurs propres à promouvoir l’oikouménê – l’habitabilité de la Terre – en réinterrogeant les paradigmes pouvant à y contribuer. Cet article développe une réflexion visant à repérer quelles seraient les caractéristiques conceptuelles et paradigmatiques cohérentes d’une communauté visant à vivifier la puissance de vie sur Terre, appelée vivifiance.

title: Écobiographie, hétérobiographie et Ateliers photobiographiques: Pour une communauté de l’intime dans un art visuel relié Ecobiography, heterobiography and photobiography workshopsTowards a community of intimacy in a connected visual art form
text_snippet: Écobiographie, hétérobiographie et Ateliers photobiographiques: Pour une communauté de l’intime dans un art visuel relié Ecobiography, heterobiography and photobiography workshopsTowards a community of intimacy in a connected visual art form In the Anthropocene era, ecobiography is emerging as a new form of self-expression based on an awareness of our interdependence with living beings. It transforms the traditional biography, centered on the individual, into a relational and situated narrative in which the subject perceives themselves as a connected being. Photography plays a key role in this process, becoming an ecobiographical gesture that encourages a sensitive and reflective exploration of the connection between the self and the world. Photobiographical workshops and the intimate photobiographical community embody this collective and ethical approach, based on reciprocity, sensitivity, and responsibility. Thus, artistic ecobiography presents itself as an ethic of living and a concrete utopia, inviting us to rethink creation, life, and our way of inhabiting the Earth in a shared consciousness of the world.

title: Crianças hospitalizadas: agentes do bem viver em comunidades do cuidado Hospitalized children: agents of well-being in caring communities Niños hospitalizados: agentes del bien vivir en comunidades de acogida
text_snippet: Crianças hospitalizadas: agentes do bem viver em comunidades do cuidado Hospitalized children: agents of well-being in caring communities Niños hospitalizados: agentes del bien vivir en comunidades de acogida This article presents research conducted in Brazil at the interface between education and health, questioning the experiences lived and narrated by children between the ages of 6 and 12 who were hospitalized for chronic diseases. It discusses the epistemological void regarding this theme and what the (auto)biographical narrative paradigm proposes. It focuses on the agency of the children participating in the research, who, beyond the accuracy of their interpretations, demonstrate the ability to create collaborative networks and act in accordance with good living and an ethic of care for themselves and others in the hospital community.

title: The Role of Jordanian Universities in Developing Vocational and Technical Education from the Point of View of Faculty Members El papel de las universidades jordanas en el desarrollo de la educación técnica y profesional desde el punto de vista de los docentes
text_snippet: The Role of Jordanian Universities in Developing Vocational and Technical Education from the Point of View of Faculty Members El papel de las universidades jordanas en el desarrollo de la educación técnica y profesional desde el punto de vista de los docentes Objectives The study aimed to identify the role of Al-Balqa Applied University in developing vocational education from the point of view of faculty members, as well as its relationship to variables such as gender, academic degree, and practical experience. Methodology To achieve the study’s objectives, a descriptive approach was used, along with a questionnaire of 24 items. This tool was administered to a sample of 100 faculty members at Al-Balqa Applied University in the first semester of the academic year 2023–2024. Results The study showed that the role of universities in developing vocational education was moderate on the study instrument as a whole. In addition, there are statistically significant differences in the role of Al-Balqa Applied University in developing vocational education, as perceived by faculty members. These differences are attributed to the gender variable favoring males and the years of experience variable in the field of vocational education. title: Prácticas supervisadas obligatorias en licenciaturas en danza en Brasil: características y trabajo de las profesoras supervisoras Mandatory supervised internships in dance teacher education programs in Brazil: Characteristics and the Work of Supervising Professors
text_snippet: Prácticas supervisadas obligatorias en licenciaturas en danza en Brasil: características y trabajo de las profesoras supervisoras Mandatory supervised internships in dance teacher education programs in Brazil: Characteristics and the Work of Supervising Professors This article, stemming from a postdoctoral research project, examines the limited systematization of Mandatory Supervised Internships (PSO) in Dance teacher education programs in Brazil and aims to describe and analyze their organization and the work of supervising professors. It reports a qualitative, multi-site study based on 35 semi-structured interviews with supervisors from 23 higher education institutions (2021-2022), analyzed using Bardin’s content analysis articulated with criteria from Krippendorff and Schreier. Findings indicate heterogeneity in stages and workloads, activity across formal and non-formal settings, mixed mentoring arrange­ments, alumni serving as host teachers, and obstacles related to infrastructure and administrative procedures. The study contributes an updated map of PSO and an analytical matrix of supervisory work to inform curriculum design, university-school agreements, and formative assessment.

title: Acompañamiento a la práctica pedagógica e investigativa en la formación docente Accompanying Teaching and Research Practice in Teacher Training
text_snippet: Acompañamiento a la práctica pedagógica e investigativa en la formación docente Accompanying Teaching and Research Practice in Teacher Training The article presents an analysis of the process of accompaniment and follow-up of pedagogical, educational and research practice in the bachelor’s programmed in Technology and Informatics at the Universidad Católica de Manizales (ucm). The study is part of research on the impact of teaching practice in the regions where students work, contributing to initial teacher training and conti­nuous improvement of the programmed. The practice is conceived as a dynamic factor of training, a scenario of interaction, feedback and construction of knowledge, where disciplinary knowledge, readings of the context and the realities of teaching are confronted. The programmed sets out strategies for counselling and ongoing support to practitioners. A qualitative methodology of descriptive cut was implemented, with the participation of 18 students who were applied to a semi-structured interview, which had a total of 25 questions. As part of the results, central aspects were identified such as the relevance of constant accompaniment, follow-up and review of the work carried out by the practitioner, as well as continuing training through practical seminars that address issues of epistemo­logical interes

title: Estudio de validez del cuestionario de autoeficacia docente del profesorado universitario en una muestra de docentes cubanos Validity Study of the Teacher Self-Efficacy Questionnaire of University Professors in a Sample of Cuban Teachers
text_snippet: Estudio de validez del cuestionario de autoeficacia docente del profesorado universitario en una muestra de docentes cubanos Validity Study of the Teacher Self-Efficacy Questionnaire of University Professors in a Sample of Cuban Teachers The study aims to analyze the validity of the Questionnaire on Teaching Self-Efficacy of University Professors in Higher Education in Cuba. A sample of 214 teachers was used. Exploratory and confirmatory factor analyses were performed to determine the construct validity of the questionnaire. The results supported a construct structured in 4 factors, with adequate goodness-of-fit indices. At the same time, the research data serve as a starting point for studies with other samples; the analysis of the items obtained and the dimensions in which they are integrated; as well as the diagnosis of teacher self-efficacy in Cuban university professors, and the proposal of actions for teacher training and professional development.

title: ¿Y si la economía se jugara? Diseño de una experiencia gamificada para estudiantes de ingeniería industrial What if Economics Were a Game? Designing a Gamified Learning Experience for Industrial Engineering Students
text_snippet: ¿Y si la economía se jugara? Diseño de una experiencia gamificada para estudiantes de ingeniería industrial What if Economics Were a Game? Designing a Gamified Learning Experience for Industrial Engineering Students Economic literacy among university students in Latin America is limited and represents an urgent challenge for higher education institutions, particularly in programs such as Industrial Engineering, where economic decision-making is essential. This study presents the design of an active pedagogical strategy for teaching key economic concepts, based on a gamified learning experience that integrates Problem-Based Learning (PBL) and the Design Thinking approach. The objective was to create a meaningful learning experience that would enable students to understand and apply essential concepts such as inflation, interest rates, and exchange rates. The methodology followed the five phases of Design Thinking: empathize, define, ideate, prototype, and test. Data were collected through interviews with instructors, surveys administered to students (n=37), classroom observations, and participatory ideation sessions. Based on this process, a ludic strategy was developed, centered on simulated business decision-making scenarios, and validated through a pilot session with students from the program. title: Uso y apropiación de la Inteligencia Artificial Generativa en docentes universitarios lasallistas de México, Colombia y Brasil Use and appropriation of generative artificial intelligence by La Salle University Faculty in Mexico, Colombia, and Brazil
text_snippet: Uso y apropiación de la Inteligencia Artificial Generativa en docentes universitarios lasallistas de México, Colombia y Brasil Use and appropriation of generative artificial intelligence by La Salle University Faculty in Mexico, Colombia, and Brazil In a constantly evolving world, where technology, educational methodologies, and labor market demands change rapidly, teachers must be prepared to impart updated and relevant knowledge. Training and education in Generative Artificial Intelligence (GAI) is essential in a world where advanced technologies are transforming key sectors such as education, healthcare, business, and more. Generative AI, which enables the creation of content, texts, images, and models from existing data, is revolutionizing the way we interact with information and automate processes. Training in this area provides professionals with the skills to leverage iag tools in solving complex problems, improving efficiency, and fostering innovation in their respective disciplines. Each discipline faces unique challenges and opportunities when integrating AI in their pedagogical practice. That is why the question arises: how have the teachers of the Lasallian network in Mexico, Colombia, and Brazil faced these situations? title: Ética e Inteligencia Artificial Generativa en la educación: perspectivas docentes de Brasil, Colombia y México Ethics and Generative Artificial Intelligence in Education: Teacher Perspectives from Brazil, Colombia, and Mexico
text_snippet: Ética e Inteligencia Artificial Generativa en la educación: perspectivas docentes de Brasil, Colombia y México Ethics and Generative Artificial Intelligence in Education: Teacher Perspectives from Brazil, Colombia, and Mexico This article analyzes the ethical concerns that Lasallian teachers in Brazil, Colombia and Mexico have regarding the use of Generative Artificial Intelligence in their educational practice. Based on a quantitative descriptive study with certain qualitative elements, a mixed questionnaire was applied to 133 higher education teachers from nine institutions located in the aforementioned countries. The findings reveal that teachers express mixed opinions regarding the IAG, reporting positive and negative experiences in the classroom. These experiences arise both from their direct interaction with technology and from their observation of the impact on the actions of the student body. In addition to this, it is contrasted that, although Brazil, Colombia and Mexico are among the countries in Latin America that have most integrated the IAG in the educational field and have promoted public debates and even the promotion of regulatory frameworks on its use, teachers still They face uncertainty about their application in the classroom from an ethical perspective.

title: Singularidades de la docencia en el área de Ciencias Sociales en Colombia Singularities of teaching in the area of ​​Social Sciences in Colombia
text_snippet: Singularidades de la docencia en el área de Ciencias Sociales en Colombia Singularities of teaching in the area of ​​Social Sciences in Colombia The research analyzes the unique teaching implemented by teachers in the area of ​​Social Sciences from 1991 to 2016. It opts for a post-structuralist approach and an archaeological-genealogical methodology, in which the deployment of practices emerge as results. of subjectivation, in relation to the critical, ethical, political and aesthetic and games of knowledge and power that outline the work of teachers, not without opposition. This concludes with the assessment of the extraordinary practices that are promoted in teaching in the area and its relevance to tension not only with curricular and instrumental pedagogical dynamics, but to affirm the care of self, others and the other.

title: El coaching en la educación: una forma de desarrollo profesional docente Coaching in education: a way of teacher professional development
text_snippet: El coaching en la educación: una forma de desarrollo profesional docente Coaching in education: a way of teacher professional development This article presents a literature review on coaching in teacher professional development. It explores different studies to define coaching, the theory it is framed in, current approaches and models, and the different methods to determine its impact on the learning of teachers and students. Although most publications consist of studies conducted in the United States, it provides an overview of the topic in Colombia. The conclusions suggest that the multiplicity of factors involved in coaching makes measuring its impact a challenge. Issues such as the professional training of coaches and the coordination of their work with school administrators remain topics of discussion.

title: Saberes prácticos del profesorado universitario: un estudio en la Universidad La Salle (México) Practical knowledge of university professors: a study at La Salle University, Mexico
text_snippet: Saberes prácticos del profesorado universitario: un estudio en la Universidad La Salle (México) Practical knowledge of university professors: a study at La Salle University, Mexico This text attempts to access and understand the practical knowledge of university professors within the classroom context, based on their experience in the mediation of workshop and laboratory-type subjects in the disciplines of Engineering, Chemistry and Architecture. The article is organized from a deductive approach in four blocks, first the knowledge is characterized with emphasis on practical knowledge, then the knowledge mentioned, is analyzed based on critical incidents and interviews from a qualitative methodology as constitutive elements in the formation of persons in higher education. The third block is an approach to the results and discussion to close up with the final reflections that give evidence of the need to recognize experience, adaptability, communication and the search for information as elements of the practical knowledge of university professors.

title: Storytelling in Secondary Education Narración en la educación secundaria
text_snippet: Storytelling in Secondary Education Narración en la educación secundaria This systematic literature review examines the impact of storytelling on secondary school learning, focusing on studies published from 2021 to 2025. Using the PRISMA protocol, 1,124 articles from Scopus, Web of Science, and ERIC were screened. After applying eligibility and quality criteria, 30 high-quality studies were analyzed thematically. Findings reveal that storytelling contributes to learning in five key areas. Cognitively, it supports understanding, critical thinking, and problem-solving. Emotionally, it enhances motivation, empathy, and inclusive classroom experiences. Linguistically, it improves literacy, creative writing, and oral communication. Culturally, storytelling fosters identity formation, civic awareness, and inclusivity. Pedagogically, it inspires innovative lesson designs, interactive resources, and student-centered assessment practices. In conclusion, storytelling is a powerful, inclusive pedagogy that can enrich secondary education.

title: Revisión Sistemática de factores protectores y de riesgo que influyen en la Permanencia Estudiantil en el contexto Latinoamericano Systematic Review of Protective and Risk Factors Influencing Student Retention in the Latin American Context
text_snippet: Revisión Sistemática de factores protectores y de riesgo que influyen en la Permanencia Estudiantil en el contexto Latinoamericano Systematic Review of Protective and Risk Factors Influencing Student Retention in the Latin American Context Objective: to systematically analyze the scientific literature to determine the risk and protective factors that influence in the student permanence according to the Latin American context. Materials and methods: Systematic literature review based on PRISMA guidelines. A literature crawl was conducted in Redalyc, Scielo, Dialnet, Google Scholar, ScienceDirect and Gale A Cengage Company, between 2014 to 2022. Results: 53 research studies were selected, most of which were developed in Colombia and mention individual, institutional, socioeconomic, academic and family factors as influential at a protective or risk level on permanence. Conclusions: The factors mentioned above are interrelated and, depending on the interaction an it’s modulation, they can be transformed as protective or risk factors

title: Educación Rural entre Montañas: Análisis de una Escuela Multinivel en Tucumán-Argentina
text_snippet: Educación Rural entre Montañas: Análisis de una Escuela Multinivel en Tucumán-Argentina Rural Education is characterized by heterogeneity as regards population, geographic location, and various pedagogical formats. The main purpose of this article is to present an interpretative analysis from a social perspective of "Escuela Multinivel Las Arquitas," located in a remote mountainous area in the province of Tucumán, Argentina. The organizational institutional model to be outlined is: a Multilevel School as an alternative capable of guaranteeing the educational trajectories of students. Moreover, the article addresses the particular configuration the teaching job adopts and the challenges involved in socio-educational inclusion processes in a mountainous environment.

title: Desafíos y oportunidades para la integración de las TIC en entornos educativos rurales
text_snippet: Desafíos y oportunidades para la integración de las TIC en entornos educativos rurales This article presents a review of academic publications addressing the challenges and opportunities for the integration of ICT in rural educational environments between 2014 and 2024. Its aim was to analyze the scientific production on the challenges and opportunities for ICT integration in the field of rural education. The methodology employed adopted a bibliometric approach, consisting of a quantitative analysis of scientific production. This review was based on the selection of 50 documents obtained from various repositories, covering five recognized databases: Scielo, Scopus, Redalyc, EBSCO, and Dialnet. The selected documents correspond to publications made between 2014 and 2024. Subsequently, the results were disseminated through the synthesis and description of the scientific production. The results show that the integration of ICT in rural educational environments faces challenges such as limited infrastructure and teacher training, along with the need for relevant content and technical maintenance. title: Inclusión y educación secundaria rural en Catamarca. Un estudio desde las condiciones laborales y actitudes de los docentes Inclusion and rural secondary education in Catamarca. A study from the working conditions and attitudes of teachers
text_snippet: Inclusión y educación secundaria rural en Catamarca. Un estudio desde las condiciones laborales y actitudes de los docentes Inclusion and rural secondary education in Catamarca. A study from the working conditions and attitudes of teachers The article examines the challenges imposed by working conditions and the meanings of inclusion negotiated by educators from rural secondary schools in the province of Catamarca-Argentina, within the framework of a national and jurisdictional educational inclusion policy that promotes the expansion of compulsory schooling. in rural areas. The field work was carried out in January 2020, with a qualitative approach. Semi-structured individual and group interviews were used as instruments for collecting information; the typification of teaching attitudes was used in the analysis. The results reveal that teachers overcoming the difficulties presented by rural areas, act as transformative agents both within the school and in the community.

title: El pasado de un futuro incierto. Memorias docentes, comunidades y cierre de escuelas rurales (Buenos Aires, Argentina, años 70-80)
text_snippet: El pasado de un futuro incierto. Memorias docentes, comunidades y cierre de escuelas rurales (Buenos Aires, Argentina, años 70-80) This article addresses the issue of rural school closures, a current yet scarcely examined problem. Our contribution lies in reconstructing, from a historical perspective, the characteristics of teaching work and its connection with rural educational communities in the province of Buenos Aires (Argentina) during the 1970s and 1980s. To achieve our objective, we chose Pila, a "rural town," as our setting. We utilized a combination of sources with an emphasis on autobiographical interviews with former teachers, which allowed us to rescue from oblivion the prior history of currently closed establishments. This approach aims to appreciate what was built, interpret the transformations experienced, and challenge persistent issues.

title: Prácticas y saberes docentes en torno a procesos del enseñar y el aprender en las intersecciones entre Educación Especial y Educación Rural: Un estudio con maestras/os de apoyo a la inclusión y docentes de aula en una escuela rural Teaching practices and knowledge about teaching and learning processes in the intersections between Special Education and Rural Education: A study with inclusion support teachers and classroom teachers in a rural school.
text_snippet: Prácticas y saberes docentes en torno a procesos del enseñar y el aprender en las intersecciones entre Educación Especial y Educación Rural: Un estudio con maestras/os de apoyo a la inclusión y docentes de aula en una escuela rural Teaching practices and knowledge about teaching and learning processes in the intersections between Special Education and Rural Education: A study with inclusion support teachers and classroom teachers in a rural school. In this article we address the teaching practices and knowledge that are built and displayed in the daily interrelationships between inclusion support teachers and classroom teachers in a rural school located in the northwest of the province of Chubut, Argentina. We focus on teaching practices and knowledge linked to teaching processes that, in the particularity of rurality, take place in a multigrade classroom. In the course of our study we recognize that these teaching practices and knowledge in rural education contexts account for certain intersections between rural education and special education. This study is carried out from an ethnographic (Rockwell, 2009) and dialectical relational approach (Achilli, 2005). title: Formar docentes para enseñar en contextos de diversidad Training teachers to teach in contexts of diversity
text_snippet: Formar docentes para enseñar en contextos de diversidad Training teachers to teach in contexts of diversity Acknowledging the limited pedagogic, didactic, and curricular production addressing teaching in rural multigrade classrooms, numerous research projects have been developed at the Faculty of Humanities and Educational Sciences of the National University of La Plata to explore this subject. This research has been further enriched by engaging with the perspective of inclusive education. In 2023, this line of work expanded its scope through a project and an extension course entitled "Rural Education: A Perspective from Teacher Training," involving educators, students, and rural teachers. In these pages, we will refer to the latest stage of this journey, highlighting the power of the dialogue between research and extension.

title: Implementación de estrategias STEAM para fortalecer el pensamiento computacional en la gestión educativa disruptiva Implementation of STEAM strategies to strengthen computational thinking in disruptive educational management
text_snippet: Implementación de estrategias STEAM para fortalecer el pensamiento computacional en la gestión educativa disruptiva Implementation of STEAM strategies to strengthen computational thinking in disruptive educational management The challenges of contemporary society and the requirement to prepare students for a constantly changing world have given rise to disruptive innovation in educational management, this method is based on the adoption of new tactics and procedures that contradict conventional wisdom and promote more interesting and relevant learning. Disruptive innovation in educational management typically aims to change the way teaching and learning take place, while fostering important skills such as creativity, critical thinking, collaboration, and problem solving. To achieve this, the STEAM methodology has been adopted, which incorporates the study of science, technology, engineering, art and mathematics into the curriculum. A descriptive quantitative approach has been used to evaluate the effects of educational innovations that allowed supporting the implementation of the methodology. The goal is to measure how much academic performance, student engagement, and motivation have changed and improved through data analysis and objective information collection.
